name: Motoboy
role: the motoboy, a Brazilian motorcycle food-delivery courier
subject_description: An adult Brazilian man in his late 20s to early 30s (a Sao Paulo motoboy in 2016), medium-brown skin, short dark wavy hair, a short trimmed beard stubble, lean average build about 1.70 m tall. Clothing, all plain and unbranded: a dark navy zip-up work jacket with silver reflective stripes across the chest and shoulders, dark jeans, black sneakers, thin black riding gloves tucked into a jacket pocket. He wears a plain black rectangular insulated delivery backpack (about 40 cm cube) on his back, and at the start of the shot he holds an open-face matte-black motorcycle helmet with a small reflective strip by its chin strap in his RIGHT hand at hip height (his right hand, attached to his right arm and shoulder, grips the strap; his LEFT hand is empty and relaxed at his side). The natural-setting pose shows him standing under a concrete guardhouse awning at dusk in a light drizzle. No company logos, no brand marks, no readable text anywhere
